profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Barry-Wehmiller Design Group
profile.summary:
Data Center and SCADA subject-matter expert with many years designing the telemetry, control, and operational-data systems that keep large-scale AI and enterprise data centers running.

Gold Certified in Ignition (Inductive Automation), I work across the full telemetry stack — field-device integration (BACnet, Modbus, OPC-UA), MQTT/Sparkplug B, historians and SQL platforms, and OT/IT integration.

I work at the intersection of deep OT expertise and modern software practice — GitOps, containerization, and applied AI for industrial environments. 

Two-time ICC Build-a-Thon finalist (2023 champion, 2025 runner-up).

Always open to connecting with others in industrial automation, data center OT, and the space where SCADA meets AI.
